scoring_justification: Only the final CSV is provided; no raw DFT output is present to recompute energies. Values are checked against paper's published DFT adsorption energies with a tolerance, and the required relative trend is enforced.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference adsorption energies (eV) from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'ΔEₐ of the K atom on an ideal graphene layer was investigated to be -0.63 eV ... N5, N6, and NQ was calculated to be -3.05, -3.44, and -0.56 eV'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported DFT values, directly traceable to the paper.

outputs.description: Computed adsorption energies of a single K atom on pristine graphene and on N5, N6, NQ doped graphene.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will compare the reported adsorption energies to the paper's DFT values with appropriate tolerance and also verify the relative trend (N6 more negative than N5, both more negative than pristine and NQ).

steps.description: Check ordering: ΔE_a(N6) < ΔE_a(N5) < ΔE_a(pristine), and ΔE_a(NQ) > ΔE_a(N5) and ΔE_a(NQ) > ΔE_a(N6)
